summary: Verified RoofSpan Office↔Field Map Parity audit. Ran backend regression suites tests/test_mobile_map_areas.py and tests/test_mobile_map_properties.py — 20/20 pass, covering: (a) /api/mobile/map/areas default-priority ordering canvass_section > territory > zip, (b) territory areas carry territory_id/name/geometry (Polygon)/bounds/scoped property_count, (c) /api/mobile/map/properties?territory_id=X returns only that territory's map-safe features with [lon,lat] coords + map-safe keys and NO contact/phone/email/notes/credentials/token fields, (d) sales user requesting an out-of-scope territory gets HTTP 403 (server-authoritative isolation), (e) canvass-section isolation between sales users returns 403 for cross-user detail, (f) Field↔Office parity — /api/mobile/map/properties?territory_id=X property IDs == /api/properties/geojson?territory_id=X (Field additionally strips invalid-coord rows), and territory geometry + property_count from /api/territories/{id} equals the territory area returned by /api/mobile/map/areas. Additionally inspected the payload for secrets — MAP_SAFE_KEYS whitelist + FORBIDDEN_KEYS deny list verified; no MapTiler key or tokens surface. Office UI (/map, owner login) verified via Playwright: 'Map view' selector shows ONLY Street and Satellite (basemap-map-button, basemap-satellite-button); basemap-buildings-button is ABSENT; Satellite toggles and renders via the secure proxy without errors; Street toggles back cleanly; territory list renders (MAP-A/MAP-B/AR-A/AR-B/MT-… seed rows visible); no console errors referencing 'buildings'. Only WebGL performance warnings from headless GPU driver observed (unrelated). Mobile MapScreen.js contains no 'buildings' references (as required — Field is Expo RN and not runnable in this env, verified via backend endpoints per instructions).

Buildings source/layer branches have been cleanly removed from MapView.jsx (only Street/Satellite basemap-* testids remain) — no dead references detected.
